result.title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
result.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents
result.summary: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「System 1 agents」：用一个确定性编译器把工具 schema 与用户请求转成多选题，再由单次前向的决策模型选择工具并填写参数，从而在本地不生成自由文本地完成工具调用；在 157 个生物医学工具的 1,952 条请求上评测了正确率与参数填写情况。
AI.relevance_reason: 将自由生成替换为「候选选项 + 单次打分」的受限决策，可能为 LVR 中约束推理状态输出、抑制被编造内容进入后续步骤提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作面向纯文本工具调用，缺乏视觉输入与 latent 状态设计。
